symbols.reasoning: Builds type/request-specific idempotency key and replays before actor lookup. Validates closed-set funding type, external-capital destination, positive amount and reason; resolves actor and optional presentation, uses returned authorization.Approver for attribution. Requires open business day before transaction. Within transaction writes one inward movement, completed financial journal and audit, saves/commits. No source balance lock needed for an inflow, but day admission precedes transaction (separate cross-workflow review needed). Conflict rolls back and looks up committed movement; contention path bounded sibling lookup. Does not validate retry payload equality; existing result wins. No extra bug claimed from that contract.
